observations.text: Per withdrawal cap: $500 maximum per withdrawal, including fees.

Card spending has no daily or monthly cap — you can spend up to the balance in your wallet, though unusually large transactions may be flagged for a compliance check. Cash is the exception: ATM withdrawals are capped at $250 per withdrawal including fees, and at three withdrawals in a rolling 24-hour window, so $750 a day. Individual ATM operators may add their own fees or restrictions.

Users from the following countries/regions are eligible to apply: Europe (EEA and UK), Latin American countries (Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, El Salvador, Guatemala, Mexico, Panama, and Peru), APAC (South Korea, Japan, Vietnam, Malaysia, Taiwan, Australia, Thailand, the Philippines, Bangladesh, Pakistan), and Africa (South Africa).
